body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-05, from w-d57f7ec79343). Two observed_terminal tests that landed with w-814b in 7eb731fc spin forever on Windows; the landing gate was a Linux FULL, where they pass. From now on, a landing that adds or changes tests using filesystem or Git fixtures (temp roots, worktree loss, path walking) gets a Windows run of those new tests before landing, even when the FULL runs on Linux. This doesn't replace the standing rule's gate. It's my check when reading condition 3 and gate evidence.
